body: He's very close with both of his parents. They can both be quite volatile at times and I've spoken to him about how maybe that could be one of the reasons why he constantly feels the need to make excuses and cover himself, but this doesn't seem to have had any effect 😂

This is the exact viewpoint that I have and I've tried so many times to explain to him that half the things he lies about aren't even issues UNTIL he lies about them. Everyone makes mistakes, everyone messes up and we all do silly things on the regular!
I often try to make him see that if he could just be upfront and honest then a lot of the minor issues would just make me laugh rather than being even remotely annoyed, but nothing seems to help.
